notes: family: tableau-set-scoring. This is BGG 205398 (2016), not the earlier eight-district edition. Resolve unique districts and character exceptions from components; input their extra points. First-completer and other-completer bonuses are mutually exclusive. Monument counts as two districts for completion; Secret Vault may score from hand. Gold and hand cards do not otherwise score.
